title: ff-world-heavyweight
label: Takeo Brown

won.source: The fed's own title history lists him under "Wednesday 1st January 2003 - Takeo Brown", the earliest entry on the belt (/promotions/ff/archive/title-history-2003-04.html).

how: Lost it to Liphe Gonne at a fightSHOW on the same day.
note: The fed's own title history dates both his reign and Liphe Gonne's to Wednesday 1 January 2003; how he came to hold it first is not in the surviving record.

title: ff-world-heavyweight
label: Liphe Gonne

won.source: The fed's own Current Champions page: "Flatlined World Heavyweight Championship Liphe Gonne • Defeated Takeo Brown at fightSHOW, 01 January 2003" (/promotions/ff/archive/current-champions-2003-02.html).

how: Lost it to Javier Garcia at Pride & Victory.

title: ff-world-heavyweight
label: Javier Garcia

won.source: The fed's own title history: "Sunday 23rd February 2003 (Pride & Victory) - Javier Garcia" (/promotions/ff/archive/title-history-2003-04.html).

how: Lost it to Frank Minio in the second round of fightSHOW: 015, and stayed on his feet after being knocked out.

title: ff-world-heavyweight
label: Frank Minio

won.source: The fed's own front-page news of 24 April 2003: "FLATLINEDfighting would like to congratulate Frank Minio, the new FLATLINED Heavyweight Champion on his victory over Javier Garcia last night on fightSHOW: 015" (/promotions/ff/archive/front-page-2003-04.html).

how: Beat Javier Garcia with a right fist thrown to counter a potential winning blow, midway through the second round.
note: Champion at the fed's own last word. Garcia had already challenged him for a CLASH in May whose date was never announced.

title: ff-world-lightweight
label: Chester Ramis

won.source: The fed's own title history, which lists exactly one holder of the belt: "Wednesday 26th March 2003 (fightSHOW) - Chester Ramis" (/promotions/ff/archive/title-history-2003-04.html).

how: The fed's own record does not say how he won it.
note: Champion at the fed's own last word. The belt was vacant on its own Current Champions page six weeks earlier.
